verdict.rationale: Hightouch's AI Decisioning product explicitly uses reinforcement learning to autonomously recommend the best message, channel, and timing per customer, and each agent bundles an audience, goals, messages, scheduling rules, and guardrails, with performance measurement built in ('then measures what worked'). This directly matches the story's autonomous-within-guardrails and measurable-lift requirements. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence or case studies quantifying actual lift, and more detail on how guardrails are configured/enforced.
